summary: A request from the University of Illinois for other network users interested in IBM's MPSX mixed integer programming package on the UCLA CCN 360/91. CCN did not yet have it, and it carried a fixed monthly rental. Illinois hoped to share the cost among several users. The estimate given was $130 a month plus $225 for the mixed integer feature.

plainLanguage.summary: The University of Illinois was considering IBM's MPSX software for mixed integer programming on the CCN system. It asked other network users if they wanted to share the rental cost.

subtitle: Seeking shared interest in an MPSX programming package

tldr.problem: The University of Illinois was considering MPSX with mixed integer programming, which carried a monthly rental cost.
tldr.mechanism: The author asks network users whether they would use the package so the cost could be divided among participating sites.
tldr.outcome: The notice seeks expressions of interest; it says the existing MPS system was available at CCN in the meantime.

today: RFC 345 is a request for interest in a proposed shared MPSX installation. It states estimated costs and does not report whether the installation took place.

sections.title: The MPSX Package
sections.content: Karl Kelley describes MPSX as a newer version of IBM's MPS mathematical programming package. He says MPSX was reported to outperform its predecessor and included a mixed integer programming feature. CCN did not then have MPSX installed.
sections.plainLanguage: MPSX was a newer IBM program for mathematical programming. The proposed installation would include its mixed integer programming option.

sections.title: Sharing the Rental Cost
sections.content: Because IBM charged a fixed monthly rental, the University of Illinois was considering asking CCN to install MPSX with the mixed integer option. The initial estimate was $130 per month for the package plus $225 for that option. The notice proposed assigning each user's share of the cost to participating sites.
sections.plainLanguage: The author gives the estimated rental prices and proposes splitting them among users. CCN could handle the cost-sharing details.

sections.title: Invitation to Contact the Author
sections.content: Kelley asks interested network users to contact him within the month. He directs questions about the mixed integer feature to Stewart Schuster at the University of Illinois. The notice also says that MPS, the earlier system, was available on the CCN system while the decision was pending.
sections.plainLanguage: Interested users were asked to respond within the month. The older MPS package remained available at CCN.
